ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Saturn

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.
